name: linear-incident-runbook
description: Analyze and contain Linear integration incidents across authentication, GraphQL, rate budgets, webhooks, and data synchronization. Use when responding to an active degradation or reconciling after an incident. Trigger with "Linear integration incident", "Linear webhook outage", or "Linear API degradation".

findings.excerpt: Use `Read`, `Glob`, and `Grep` to inspect code, configuration, and evidence. Use `WebFetch` only for current first-party Linear documentation and package metada
